game_title: Call Stack Tower – Cold Larder Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in Snowy Hold – Cold Larder, an ice-cellar larder: the hold guard must handle frozen golems while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Cold Larder: an ice-cellar larder
core_gameplay_loop: In Cold Larder, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the hold guard ahead. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the beacon fire by solving code steps involving stack_height that move the hold guard forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the beacon fire first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 2 (intro tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
